build.note: Official default is evmVersion=shanghai which emits PUSH0 (verified: 330 PUSH0 in IdentityRegistry creation code). PikoChain genesis has no Shanghai, so rebuilt for paris. Executable code is PUSH0-free (one 0x5f byte sits inside the CBOR metadata tail, never executed).

canonicalAddresses.reason: Official canonical addresses are CREATE2 vanity deployments of the shanghai-compiled bytecode, owned by the ERC-8004 team key (0x547289319C3e6aedB179C0b8e8aF0B5ACd062603). PikoChain cannot use shanghai bytecode (PUSH0 unsupported); recompiling for paris changes the init-code hash so the same factory+salt yields different addresses. The team owner key is unavailable, so the canonical proxies could never be upgraded to functional implementations on PikoChain anyway.

feedbackHelper.role: test-only helper so feedback comes from a non-owner address (self-feedback is forbidden by the official contract)

minimalUUPS.role: HardhatMinimalUUPS placeholder implementation (test-mode owner pattern, same as official test suite)

note: LOCAL TEST DEPLOYMENT ONLY. Not mainnet, no real funds, no private keys read. Deployer is the local geth unlocked test account.
